Name: JP's Halloween Monsters
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][center][b][i][color=#9900ff][u]Halloween Monsters[/u][/color][/i][/b][/center][/size]
[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Because having monsters of different colors adds a bit of immersion and variety to the game, although with how little time they'll last at the edge of your sword, it's not that big of a deal...[/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=3][b]Thanks to Monster Variety, you can now have multiple different monsters roaming around the mine, with rather creepy appearances that may make you feel somewhat uncomfortable...
Well, that's all, folks. 

[/b][/size][b][size=3]For now, they are simply skins of the original monsters. [color=#00ffff]There are three different ones for each monster and another three for each Dangerous version[/color]. In the future, I may add unique loot or some kind of interaction, who knows. [/size][/b][size=3][b]
[/b][/size]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][i]I hope you like the mod and wish you a happy Halloween. Don't eat too much sugar, folks![/i][/size][/color]
